newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Four Seasons plans 50 mln punt Irish hotel.
newsitem.headline: Four Seasons plans 50 mln punt Irish hotel.

text.p: International hotel chain Four Seasons Hotels Inc on Wednesday said it planned a 50 million Irish pound hotel in Dublin's Royal Dublin Society (RDS) site.
The hotel, which will be developed by Irish-based development company Simmonscourt Holdings Ltd, will create up to 300 jobs and is scheduled to open in 1999.
"As Dublin continues to experience economic growth, the timing is ideal for a new luxury hotel of Four Seasons calibre", Four Seasons chairman and CEO Isadore Sharp said in a statement.
The new hotel, named Four Seasons Hotel Dublin, will be residential in style with approximately 250 rooms in a garden setting, the statement said.
